teaser: A half-packed bag by the door, zipper still open. Life path 5 crossed with ENTP is restlessness doubled: one system built on motion, the other built on possibility, both impatient with the room they're standing in. You are quick to name what could change and quicker to start changing it, moving to the next idea before the last one has finished unpacking. This is the Reading for when the pull toward the next thing and the delight in rearguing the last thing arrive in the same body, where the question is rarely whether to move but how many directions call out at once.
